messages:
maria: Hey folks — first week here! Who should I ping to get added to PagerDuty and the eng-oncall rotation? Also unsure which runbooks I should study first before my shadow shift tomorrow.
sam: welcome, @maria! :tada: I’ll take care of PagerDuty add. Quick checklist: 1) PD invite 2) Slack escalation group 3) VPN access to the private runbooks. I’ll DM you for your work email.
maria: thanks @sam — my email is maria@redwood.com. When do shadows typically start? is there a doc that lists the common alerts?
priya: hey @maria — shadows are usually 2 shifts long (first is observational, second you take pager with a follow-up). Start times are on the rota: https://console.redwood.ai/oncall/rota
priya: For runbooks, start with: /runbooks/ingress-500s, /runbooks/kv-cache-corruption, and /runbooks/model-fallbacks. They’re short (5–8 steps) and have a TL;DR at the top.
priya: pro tip: read the rollback section first — it’s the fastest path to mitigating a bad rollout.
oncall-bot: Reminder: New on-call training video available — watch before shadowing: https://videos.redwood.ai/oncall-101 (15m). Reaction :white_check_mark: if done.
maria: got it — will watch the vid now. Any special creds needed to view private runbooks?
sam: yes — we use team KMS + SSO. infra-bot will grant runbook read access once PD invite is accepted. infra-bot, please?
infra-bot: Grant request received. Action: add user maria to group eng-oncall-read. ETA: 5 minutes.
maria: thanks! Also: what’s the expected response SLA for paging during a shadow vs when I’m on-call solo?
sam: during shadow, just observe and ask questions in thread — you don’t need to ack pages. When you’re primary: ack within 5m and start an incident thread within 10m for sev2/sev1.
priya: and follow the incident template: create thread in #incidents, put a short summary, severity, initial mitigation, and whether to bridge. Example header: "[INCIDENT][sev2] model-latency - 50% errors".
maria: perfect. One last Q — who do I ping if I don’t know which runbook applies?
sam: ping me or @priya. If unclear, create a quick thread in #eng-oncall with logs (paste minimal stack) and we’ll triage which runbook fits.
maria: awesome — thanks everyone. I’ll mark the video done and wait for PD + runbook access.
oncall-bot: maria marked training as complete. Badge: New Oncall Trainee.
sam: welcome aboard again. I’ll schedule a 30m shadow handoff at 09:30 tomorrow — calendar invite incoming. :calendar: 
maria: calendar received, see you then!
